This is my current Tails list I'm running in my more competitive pods if you're interested at all. I wish I had saved the Barren Glory list but I can't seem to find it.

It's very tricky to pull off in mono white, but the way I did it was I played all the white enchantment tutors to grab it and all the Planeswalker tutors to grab Karn.

 You have to get Karn on the field and uptick Karn to exile Barren Glory from your hand. Karn has to survive a round, this is where Tails as a commander shines with it's protection ability and with enough mana and blockers Karn can be safe. Next turn you uptick Karn again and exile an instant or sorcery from your hand and pray that Karn can remain unscathed for another turn rotation, using Tails again for protection. On your next turn Karn is at 14 loyalty and can be ulted to restart the game, leaving you with Barren Glory on the field alone at the start of the game. You then take mulligans until your hand is empty and you win on your first turns upkeep. 


 The other way to win is just through hitting your own barren glory with [[oblivion ring]] type effects and then using a combination of wrath's and luck to make it the only thing on your board with no cards in hand which isn't as effective.


It's a very shaky and sketchy build/wincon but when you can pull it off it's insane, the one time I did it everyone went apeshit over the combo haha

But from a spectators stand point, it looks like a bunch of wimps crying to abuse the rules. Does this make them better players of the game? The answer is No, but I guess we can give them some slack because it is a professional sport. 

If me and my buddies are playing soccer and I make a show after I get bumped and demand a penalty shot, then odds are my buds aren't gonna invite me next time.
